dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Meikle River area (NTS 84E/SE) (GIS data, line features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the line features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 571, Surficial Geology of the Meikle River Area (NTS 84E/SE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Meikle River Area (NTS 84E/SE) (GIS data, line features)
